description: An absolute same-host stylesheet answers 404: critical silently DROPS it and succeeds with the other sheets.

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on the page's own host fails the whole job (decision: shipping critical css that silently lacks the owner's own rules is worse than shipping none). (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: "same host" must compare host:port, as the url() rebasing does, or be injectable.)
